title: Your weight is data, not a daily report card. 👏
hook: Your weight is data, not a daily report card. 👏
caption:
Your weight is data, not a daily report card. 👏

You can eat less than usual, wake up 4 lbs heavier, and still be making progress.

One weigh-in doesn’t tell you whether you’ve gained fat, lost muscle, or made progress.

Your weight can fluctuate because of water retention, sodium, digestion, hormones, stress, and recovery.
